title: RAW UNREVIEWED: zodiac exception slots test whether labels target figures or star states
summary: The validated public source inventory gives a rare built-in contrast: f72r2 has one labelled figure without a star and a different star-bearing figure without a label, while f70v2 has an extra label beside a central star without a corresponding figure. Do not equate the 29 stars and 29 labels or assign every label to a star. Freeze all twelve admitted zodiac panels, the exact exceptional physical slots and complete three-reader label surfaces before looking at their words. Compare a figure-address account (the f72r2 starless figure retains ordinary figure-label syntax; the central f70v2 label is a different register/header), a star-state account (label behavior tracks stars despite the exceptions), and a serial-position account (labels are slot codes unrelated to either depicted carrier). A usable result requires an independently visible owner or a repeated exceptional carrier on a second physical leaf; a single anomalous spelling or shared prefix is only exploratory. Historical page exposure and the aggregate ownership correction are explicit; no meaning or significance follows from the count coincidence.

design.mechanism: missing and extra illustrated carriers provide a physical exception test for figure, star-state and serial-label accounts
design.unit: all twelve admitted zodiac panels, with f72r2 starless-labelled and star-bearing-unlabelled slots plus f70v2 central extra label fixed from public source notes
design.contrast: figure-address versus star-state versus serial-position labels, evaluated on complete label surfaces and preserved exception ownership
design.prediction: a figure-address reading must explain an ordinary label at a starless figure and treat the central-star-only label as a different role; a star-state reading must give a coherent account of both f72r2 exceptions; a serial-position reading predicts no carrier-class-specific behavior. If no singular second-leaf owner or discriminating syntax exists, stop as missing meaning binding.
design.scope: exploratory target-first anomaly; no reserved pages, no translated word
